# Functions

```{r}
interpolate <- function(df_small, first_day, last_day) {
  
  days = seq(first_day, last_day, by = "days")

  df1 <- data.frame("fecha" = days)
  
  df <- left_join(df1, df_small, by = "fecha")

  df_int <- df |> 
  select(-fecha) |>  
  apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN = as.numeric)|> 
  apply(MARGIN = 2, FUN = na_interpolation)
  
  df_int <- as.data.frame(df_int)
  
  df_int["fecha"] = df1["fecha"]
  
  weeks_date <- seq(first_day, last_day, by = "week")
  
  df_filter_weeks <- df_int %>% 
  filter(fecha %in% weeks_date) %>% 
  select(1:ncol(df_int))
  
  df_filter_weeks <- df_filter_weeks |> 
  mutate(year = isoyear(fecha)) |> 
  filter(year %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(week1 = isoweek(fecha)) |> 
  mutate(week = paste(year, week1, sep = "-")) |> 
  filter(week != "2021-53") |> 
  filter(week != "2020-53") |> 
  filter(week != "2022-53") |> 
  filter(week != "2023-53") |>
  filter(week != "2024-53") |>
  filter(week != "2025-53") |> 
  select(-c(fecha, year, week1))
  
  return(df_filter_weeks)
}

interpolate_ndvi <- function(df_small, first_day, last_day) {
  
  days = seq(first_day, last_day, by = "days")

  df1  <- tibble(fecha = days)
  
  df <- left_join(df1, df_small, by = "fecha")

  num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "fecha")
  X <- as.matrix(df[num_cols])

  X_imp <- matrix(nrow = nrow(X), ncol = ncol(X))
  colnames(X_imp) <- num_cols

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X))) {
    x_ts <- ts(X[, j], frequency = 365)
    X_imp[, j] <- na_seadec(x_ts, algorithm = "interpolation")
  }

  df_int <- as_tibble(X_imp, .names = num_cols) |>
    bind_cols(fecha = df$fecha)
   weeks_date <- seq(first_day, last_day, by = "week")
  
  df_filter_weeks <- df_int %>% 
  filter(fecha %in% weeks_date) %>% 
  select(1:ncol(df_int))
  
  df_filter_weeks <- df_filter_weeks |> 
  mutate(year = isoyear(fecha)) |> 
  filter(year %in% c(2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(week1 = isoweek(fecha)) |> 
  mutate(week = paste(year, week1, sep = "-")) |> 
  filter(week != "2021-53") |> 
  filter(week != "2020-53") |> 
  filter(week != "2022-53") |> 
  filter(week != "2023-53") |>
  filter(week != "2024-53") |>
  filter(week != "2025-53") |> 
  select(-c(fecha, year, week1))
  
  return(df_filter_weeks)
}

interpolate_lst <- function(df_small, first_day, last_day) {
  
  days = seq(first_day, last_day, by = "days")

  df1  <- tibble(fecha = days)
  
  df <- left_join(df1, df_small, by = "fecha")

  num_cols <- setdiff(names(df), "fecha")
  X <- as.matrix(df[num_cols])

  X_imp <- matrix(nrow = nrow(X), ncol = ncol(X))
  colnames(X_imp) <- num_cols

  for (j in seq_len(ncol(X))) {
    x_ts <- ts(X[, j], frequency = 365)
    X_imp[, j] <- na_seadec(x_ts, algorithm = "interpolation")
  }

  df_int <- as_tibble(X_imp, .names = num_cols) |>
    bind_cols(fecha = df$fecha)
  
  return(df_int)
}
```

```{r}
canton_week <- function(df, var_name) {
  df_pivot = pivot_longer(df, cols = -c("week"), names_to = "code", values_to = var_name)
df_pivot <- df_pivot |> 
  mutate(week_canton = paste(week, code, sep = "-")) |> 
  select(week_canton, var_name)
  return(df_pivot)
}
```

# LST

```{r}
baseLST <- read.csv("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/baseLST.csv")
baseLST <- baseLST |> 
  mutate(fecha = ymd(fecha)) |>
  mutate(lst1 = case_when(
  lst < 0 ~ NA,
  TRUE ~ lst  
)) |> 
  select(lst1, fecha, ID) 
```

```{r}
baseLST_wide <- pivot_wider(baseLST, names_from = ID, values_from =  lst1) 
```

```{r}

  select(-c("607"))
```
```{r}
baseLST_int <- interpolate_lst(baseLST_wide, first_day = ymd("2020-01-01"), last_day = ymd("2025-12-31"))
```

```{r}
baseLST_int_long <- baseLST_int |>  pivot_longer(cols = -c("fecha"), names_to = "ID", values_to = "lst")
```

```{r}
baseLST_int_long
```

```{r}
lst_weekly_site <- baseLST_int_long |> 
  group_by(ID, year = isoyear(fecha), week1 = isoweek(fecha)) |>
  summarise(lst_min = min(lst), 
            lst_max = max(lst),
            lst_mean = mean(lst),
            lst_median = median(lst),
    .groups = "drop" )  |> 
  mutate(week = paste(year, week1, sep = "-")) |> 
  filter(!grepl("-53$", week))|> 
  filter(!grepl("^2026", week))
```
```{r}
lst_weekly_site
```
```{r}
lst_weekly <- lst_weekly_site |> 
  select(-c(year, week1))
```

```{r}
para_eda <- function(df, var) {
  df_new <- df |> 
    select(c(week, ID, var)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = ID, values_from = var, id_cols = week)
  write.csv(df_new, file = paste0("C:/Users/nan/OneDrive - Universidad de Costa Rica/cuenta personal/ucr pers/practica profesional/practica dengue/dengue-model/data/raw/", var, "_eda.csv"))
}
```

```{r}
para_eda(lst_weekly, "lst_min")

para_eda(lst_weekly, "lst_max")

para_eda(lst_weekly, "lst_mean")

para_eda(lst_weekly, "lst_median")
```

# El Niño

## SST

```{r}
baseSST1 <-
  read_table('https://www.cpc.ncep.noaa.gov/data/indices/ersst5.nino.mth.91-20.ascii')
```
```{r}
baseSST1 <- baseSST1 |> 
  filter(YR %in% seq(2020, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(MON1 = case_when(MON == 1 ~ "01", 
                          MON == 2 ~ "02", 
                          MON == 3 ~ "03", 
                          MON == 4 ~ "04",
                          MON == 5 ~ "05",
                          MON == 6 ~ "06", 
                          MON == 7 ~ "07", 
                          MON == 8 ~ "08",
                          MON == 9 ~ "09",
                          MON == 10 ~ "10", 
                          MON == 11~ "11",
                          MON == 12 ~ "12"))
baseSST1 <- baseSST1 |> 
  mutate(fecha1 = paste(YR, MON1, "15", sep = "-")) |> 
  mutate(fecha = ymd(fecha1)) |> 
  select(fecha = fecha,
         nino34ssta = ANOM_3)
```

```{r}
baseSST_int <- interpolate(baseSST1, first_day = ymd("2020-01-01"), last_day =  ymd("2025-12-31"))
```

```{r}
baseSST_int
```

```{r}
baseSST1 <- baseSST1 |> 
  filter(YR %in% seq(2020, 2025)) |> 
  mutate(MON1 = case_when(MON == 1 ~ "01",

                          MON == 3 ~ "03", 
                          MON == 4 ~ "04",
```
